resources.string: Connection checks contact Google, and approximate IP-based location comes from ipwho.is. VPN checks use the selected VPN network; location checks without VPN use the current internet connection. These services see the requests and their source IP address. Profiles and settings are encrypted on this device. No advertising or analytics SDK is included.

In Router, you can install FoxHole on supported OpenWrt or connect your phone to an existing FoxHole installation. Question-mark buttons next to settings open help. Unpairing disables management; to revoke VPN access, delete the client separately.

When enabled in Settings → Background updates, subscriptions refresh about every 12 hours and signed connection-data updates are checked every 24 hours by default. Turn either check off there. FoxHole DB connection-data updates are installed when you take action. With subscription auto-refresh enabled, profiles update automatically when they can be safely replaced. Android may delay background checks. F-Droid manages app updates for its builds.
